title: Sequence SLI Drift Guardian: simulation harness + regional spillover ops dashboard
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation:
We observe subtle, gradual SLI drift for long-sequence workloads that often precedes regional spillovers and latent circuit state changes. This ticket builds a simulation + dashboard pairing to detect per-sequence SLI drift earlier than coarse p99 rollups, validate regional fallback behaviors, and provide on-call playbook hooks.

Scope / Goals:
- Add sequence-cohort drift scoring (per-customer or per-tenant where possible) computed from token-level latency distributions and KV-hit deltas.
- Surface a dashboard that correlates cohort drift with cross-region spillover, circuit transitions, and admission-rate changes.
- Provide a simulation harness to synthesize traffic that reproduces slow drift, bursty spillover, and progressive circuit activation.
- Produce remediation runbook snippets and threshold suggestions for dynamic shed controllers.

Why different from existing dashboards:
- Focus on "drift" as a continuous score (0-100) per sequence cohort using statistical windowing rather than only discrete SLI alerts.
- Emphasis on linking sequence-length and model-variant mixing to early warning signals for multi-region failover.
- Includes an automated sweep of admission-controller heuristics to suggest failover hysteresis parameters.

Instrumentation plan (metrics to add):
- sequence.latency.token.hist_p50/p95/p99 (tagged by region, shard, sequence_cohort, model_variant)
- sequence.kv.cache_hit_ratio (per model_variant, region)
- sequence.kv.prefetch_latency_mean
- admission.rate.accept / admission.rate.reject by region and priority
- circuit.state_change{from,to} (event stream with timestamp)
- spillover.outbound.requests_by_region
- seq.cohort.drift_score (derived metric computed in ingestion pipeline)

Prometheus/Datadog example queries (illustrative):
- p99 token latency for cohort X in region us-west: avg:histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(sequence_latency_bucket{sequence_cohort="X", region="us-west"}[5m]))
- cohort drift score (simple): increase(sequence.latency.scroll_delta_sum{sequence_cohort="X"}[30m]) / increase(sequence.latency.count{sequence_cohort="X"}[30m])
- spillover flow: sum(rate(spillover_outbound_requests_total[1m])) by (from_region,to_region)

Dashboard panels (minimum viable set):
1) Cohort Drift Heatmap — cohorts on Y axis, time on X, color = drift_score. Click opens cohort detail.
2) Sequence-level token latency waterfall — p50/p95/p99 stacked for selected cohort and region.
3) KV cache health — hit ratio + prefetch latency with model_variant breakdown.
4) Admission controller decisions timeline — accept/reject rate + configured hysteresis overlaid.
5) Circuit state timeline — discrete steps with event annotations and correlated downstream failures.
6) Regional spillover sankey panel — shows percent of requests rerouted between regions during incidents.
7) Simulation control + replay panel — config knobs (burstiness, drift slope, sequence length mix) and result summary.

Simulation harness plan:
- Implement a driver that can send sequences with controlled length distributions, per-token generation delays, and optional KV-hit injection.
- Provide deterministic seeds so runs are reproducible across regions.
- Sweep parameters: drift_slope (0-5 ms/min), burst_factor (1-100x), seq_length_median (16-4096), kv_hit_rate (0-1).
- Capture golden signals during sweep and produce CSVs for offline analysis and model of early-warning thresholds.

Acceptance criteria (must be met to close ticket):
- Dashboard deployed in staging with all 7 panels and drilldowns working.
- seq.cohort.drift_score populated for top 50 cohorts and visible in dashboard.
- Simulation harness available in repo with at least 3 repeatable scenarios and sample results attached.
- Runbook stub created with recommended hysteresis for admission-controller and clear escalation steps.
- One on-call runbook play executed in staging and logged as a follow-up note.

Implementation tasks (workflow):
- Instrumentation: add sequence.cohort.drift_score derivation to metrics ingestion pipeline. (Owner: Marco)
- Metrics tagging: ensure sequence and kv metrics include sequence_cohort and model_variant tags. (Owner: Lina)
- Dashboard: assemble panels in Datadog/Grafana and wire drilldowns. (Owner: Marcus)
- Simulation: add harness, runner, and perf collection to infra repo. (Owner: Marco)
- Runbook: document detection -> mitigation -> rollback steps. (Owner: Aisha)

Rollout & Validation plan:
- Week 1: staging rollout of metrics + basic panels, run 3 sims, iterate on drift formula.
- Week 2: expand cohort coverage to top-200 tenants, validate thresholds, run chaos test (limit capacity in us-west).
- Week 3: soft rollout to prod as monitoring-only, enable alerting for top-10 cohorts with tuned thresholds.

Risks & Mitigations:
- Noise in drift_score for low-traffic cohorts -> mitigate by minimum-sample gating and smoothing windows.
- Metric cardinality explosion due to cohort tagging -> mitigate by restricting cohorts to top-N and sampling low-volume tenants.
- False positives triggering failover -> start as monitoring-only and only suggest hysteresis changes; do not auto-failover until validated.
